text: Praise to David. I will exalt thee my God, the King, and I will praise thy name forever and ever.
In all the day I will praise thee, and I will praise thy name forever and ever.
Great is Jehovah, and being greatly praised; and to his greatness no search.
Generation to generation shall praise thy works, and they shall announce thy powers.
I will speak the splendor of the honor of thy majesty, and the words of thy wonders.
And they shall tell the strength of thy terrible things, and I will recount thy greatnesses.
They shall pour forth the remembrance of the multitude of thy goodness, and they shall shout forth thy justice.
Jehovah is compassionate and merciful; slow to anger, and great of mercy.
Jehovah is good to all, and his mercies over all his works.
All thy works shall praise thee, O Jehovah, and thy godly ones shall praise thee.
They shall tell the glory of thy kingdom, and they shall speak of thy strength;
To make known to the sons of man his powers, and the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
Thy kingdom a kingdom of all times, and thy dominion in every generation and generation.
Jehovah upholds to all falling, and raises up for all bowed down.
The eyes of all hope for thee, and thou givest to them their food in its time.
Opening thy hand and filling the desire to all living.
Jehovah is just in all his ways, and merciful in all his works.
Jehovah is near to all calling upon him, to all who shall call upon him in truth.
He will do the desire of them fearing him, and he will hear their cry and he will save them.
Jehovah watches all loving him, and all the unjust he will destroy.
My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah, and all flesh shall bless his holy name forever and ever.
